phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.notes: Checked official Tauri, xterm.js, and Monaco sources for the executable MVP boundary.

phases.label: Scope selection
phases.notes: Selected bounded CLI discovery/version health checks instead of interactive PTY execution.

phases.label: Implementation
phases.notes: Added Tauri CLI adapter health commands, Workspace Monitor Desktop tab, CSS, view mode registry update, readiness checks, and tests.

phases.label: Verification
phases.notes: Ran Workspace Monitor check/test/build, platform desktop tests/readiness, view mode checks, resource, grounding, CLI pipeline, timing, naming, structure, and diff checks.

phases.label: Evaluation
phases.notes: Prepared omission, resource, grounding, CLI pipeline, request trace, work summary, and evaluator records.

bottleneck_analysis.bottleneck_notes: The main cost was keeping the first implementation useful while avoiding premature PTY, installer, and source-affecting execution risk.
improvement_candidates: Add a deterministic Rust compile gate once the Rust toolchain is installed through an audit record.
Create a narrow PTY POC spec before adding xterm.js or stdin write support.
